item.title: Trump warns Iran’s new leader won’t ‘last long’ without his approval
item.summary: Trump warns Iran's new leader won't "last long" without U.S. approval as Operation Epic Fury enters second week following Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's assassination.

item.title: The unlikely tool Trump is eyeing to tackle rising oil prices amid the Iran conflict
item.summary: War-risk insurance costs surge as conflict threatens oil shipments through Strait of Hormuz, potentially driving up gas prices for American consumers.

item.title: Mehdi Hasan tells MS NOW'S Chris Hayes that 'even the Nazis' behaved better than Trump's military
item.summary: Former MS NOW host Mehdi Hasan tells Chris Hayes that U.S. military conduct in Iran is worse than Nazi behavior, following a strike the U.S. is investigating.

item.title: CENTCOM issues safety warning to Iranian civilians as regime uses ‘heavily populated’ areas for launches
item.summary: CENTCOM warned Iranian civilians to avoid military-linked sites, accusing Tehran of launching drones and missiles from populated areas.

item.title: White House says oil price spike is temporary as Trump pushes energy dominance amid Iran war
item.summary: Karoline Leavitt says oil price spike from Iran conflict will be short-lived as President Trump's energy dominance strategy stabilizes markets and eases pressure on American consumers.

item.title: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase delivers expletive-filled reaction to Ravens trading for Maxx Crosby: 'Oh my God!'
item.summary: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase unleashed an expletive-filled rant on a livestream after learning the Ravens traded for Raiders pass rusher Maxx Crosby.

item.title: Police swarm NYC street Sunday amid IED probe near Gracie Mansion
item.summary: Police activity on the Upper East Side follows confirmation that a protest-thrown device was an IED capable of causing serious injury or death.

item.title: Air Force veteran warns 'cartels don’t collapse — they fracture' after notorious drug lord killed
item.summary: Death of cartel kingpin "El Mencho" marks major win against fentanyl trafficking, but expert says sustained pressure is still needed to combat cartels.

item.title: Trump admin turns Venezuela into major US oil supplier as global shipping crisis eases
item.summary: Major policy shift sees Venezuela become key U.S. oil supplier under Trump administration, with new contracts signed for Gulf Coast refineries.

item.title: UFC announces card for White House event
item.summary: The UFC announced its card for the America 250 event that will take place in Washington, D.C., on June 14. Two championship bouts headline the action.
